title: Reject linked output paths before creating research drafts
body:
The draft generator validates source paths but can create its output through a symlinked research directory. Check the output path with the existing repository symlink/junction validator before any Git reads or staging writes. A checkout root alias remains allowed; a linked component below that root is rejected.

Validation: 6 scaffold tests and all onboarding tests pass on Python 3.12; the 3 new alias tests pass under `-O`. Tests preserve an external sentinel file, reject a dangling package alias without staging, and retain normal validation through a linked checkout root. Existing exact-pin and no-overwrite controls pass. `git diff --check` passes. Native Windows junction handling uses the existing validator; no native Windows run was made.

Fresh canonical main/priorities and live PR/Discussion overlap checked. No other active PR touches this generator. This changes draft creation only, with no selected-frontier effect. Hosted CI is pending.

Base: `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`. Verified head: `9a49794b08658da52f83b3a3b214366136808740`.

Prepared for aliromman with OpenAI Codex assistance. Existing tool and predecessor credits remain in place. No selected-frontier change.
